data.long_meaning: The name Obediah is derived from the Hebrew roots ‘obed’ meaning ‘servant’ and ‘yah’ meaning ‘God’. The name can be interpreted as ‘servant of God’. This name was borne by a number of figures in the Old Testament, including a prophet and a Levite.
